title: Diamond in the Rough
summary:
African product trades present a growing opportunity
Over the last five years, the refined product trades into sub- Saharan Africa have increased dramatically. Based on the outlook for product demand relative to projections for African refinery output, the outlook for the next five years is also quite promising, driven mostly by the traditional powerhouses of South Africa and Nigeria. They are the largest African economies by far - together they account for more than half of the sub-Saharan economy.
